title: Document the local restore procedure
description: As a local operator, I need a documented restore procedure so I can recover a requirement workspace without reusing previous credentials.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] The restore guide contains a tested recovery command | Verify: execute the guide in an isolated temporary workspace
- [ ] Previous capability keys are rejected after restore | Verify: attempt authentication with a pre-restore key and observe rejection

source.text: Provide a tested local restore guide. Reject previous keys after restoration.
